title: Nucor’s Raises Price $10/ton: What the March 2026 CSP Move Means for US Steel Buyers
content:
Nucor's Consumer Spot Price for hot rolled coil has climbed steadily with Nucor now announcing a $10/ton increase effective March 23rd 2026

The post Nucor’s Raises Price $10/ton: What the March 2026 CSP Move Means for US Steel Buyers appeared on Steel Industry News.
